strings.name: Peter Howitt
strings.summary: Howitt trained in economics in Canada and the United States and taught at Western Ontario, Ohio State and Brown. With Philippe Aghion, he developed models explaining growth through innovation and creative destruction, examining how new technologies raise productivity while displacing older firms and skills. They shared the 2025 economics Nobel with Mokyr. His research continues to inform debates on growth and innovation policy.
